Initial release of Elderly Loneliness Detection & Warm Companionship skill.

- Analyzes video (and optional audio) from fixed cameras in elderly living spaces to detect loneliness-related behaviors (e.g., prolonged solitude, static gazing, sighing, talking-to-self).
- Calculates a composite loneliness index (0-100) and, when above a threshold, automatically triggers companionship actions (e.g., playing pre-recorded family messages, favorite songs, or notifying adult children).
- Supports real-time monitoring and proactive intervention to improve senior mental well-being.
- Strict open-id acquisition workflow ensures privacy and correct usage before any analysis or report retrieval.
- Can be integrated into smart cameras or elderly-care platforms as an emotional support feature for smart aging scenarios.
